serious_candidates.R_reason: Clear yes/no outcome depending on Sony's official hardware release roadmaps.
serious_candidates.S_reason: Sony Interactive Entertainment is the official, definitive corporate source.
serious_candidates.T_reason: Targeting late 2027 captures the rumored phase-out window.
serious_candidates.U_reason: A complete abandonment of discs is highly controversial and financially risky, making Sony's final timing uncertain.
serious_candidates.H_reason: Widely discussed across worldwide tech and gaming outlets.

BDLT.B_reason: PlayStation is the dominant console platform in the Philippines; any change to disc play affects local buy/sell/trade culture.
BDLT.D_reason: Massive disagreement over whether Sony will completely cut off the physical market so soon.
BDLT.L_reason: Directly impacts hundreds of local game shops (e.g., Datablitz, iTech) and the local pre-owned game market.
BDLT.T_reason: Long-term market but highly relevant to the upcoming console mid-generation or next-generation cycles.

serious_candidates.why_users_bet: PlayStation's dominance in the Philippines means a shift to all-digital hardware would immediately disrupt local retail stores and secondary markets, creating intense community interest.
